ITEM.PTXT: When the engine switch is turned to IG ON, the SRS airbag warning light illuminates for approximately 6 seconds and the primary check is performed. During this period, ignition is prohibited and the operation of the center airbag sensor is diagnosed. If a malfunction is detected during this primary check, the SRS airbag warning light remains illuminated and does not go off even after 6 seconds have elapsed.
For a center airbag sensor that has deployed the airbags, the SRS airbag warning light remains illuminated even after the primary check, regardless of whether there is a malfunction.
